tasks.redPrompt:
Write the FAILING test suite for #262 — schedule_item UI. The type EXISTS on both dbs (child of event 1→0..N; props name:string + datetime:datetime, both required; sort datetime then name tie-break; NO ordinal anywhere — adjudicated on #246; rights program_item-identical: parent-event _editor writes, _sharing domain).

CONTRACT (letter-first): mvox-app#262 PO comments — 05:30 v1 shape + 11:11 agenda amendment. Read both via `gh issue view 262 --comments` before writing a single spec.

## Surface A — event detail page (src/routes/event/[id]/+page.svelte)
1. A NEW schedule section with its OWN container and testid (e.g. event-detail-schedule). It MUST NOT render inside [data-testid="event-detail-time"] — page.spec.ts:637 and :2414 pin exact-count regexes on that element's textContent (`match(/19:00/g).toHaveLength(1)`), and a schedule item sharing the event's start time (the likely 'kontsert' fixture) would break them. Placement within the page hierarchy is engineering's call (near the event's own date/time block, PO directional); assert presence + content, not absolute position.
2. Chronological list: each row shows name + time. Time renders via the existing combo formatTime(tallinnHHMM(new Date(iso)), $timeFormatStore) — the ONLY legal time renderer (timeFormat.no-hardcoded-render.spec.ts allowlist fence). Write an AM/PM-mode spec (profile pref 'ampm' → '7:00 PM' style) and a 24h default spec. Sort: datetime ascending, name tie-break — pin with a fixture where two items share a datetime.
3. Members (non-editor) SEE the list, get ZERO edit affordances. Parent-event editors (the page's existing isEditor derivation — manageRightsFrom(ownerIds, editorIds, personId)) get add/edit/remove. Section visibility follows the Works precedent (rows.length>0 || isEditor): member + zero items → section absent; editor + zero items → section with add affordance.
4. Editor CRUD idiom = the existing in-situ family: add in place (visible labels — #239/#249 single-name rule: a visible <label>/<span> names each control, NO redundant same-key aria-label); edit via the pencil pattern (whole-field activator, TAB-reachable — standing rule 4/4b, reference admin/+page.svelte:513-531); remove behind the two-step arm→confirm/cancel with the red trashcan (TrashIcon.svelte inside the trigger button, aria-hidden icon, accessible name on the button — #238 shape as used at routes/+page.svelte:5845-5855; NOT the older × glyph). Time entry in add/edit uses TimeSelect.svelte (the app's ONE sanctioned time-entry composite — native selects, honors AM/PM pref); name entry is a native text input.
5. Wire specs (drive the REAL producer, no hand-set state — assert full shapes with toEqual, not objectContaining): fetch = entuFetch GET `entity?_type.string=schedule_item&_parent.reference=<eventId>&props=name,datetime&limit=500` (mirror listProgramItems, repertoireData.ts:88-110; NEVER a raw type id — per-db ids differ: polyphony 6a9ccea4… vs crede 6a9cceab…). create = POST entity with props [{type:'_type',reference:<resolveTypeId(cfg,'schedule_item')>},{type:'_parent',reference:eventId},{type:'name',string},{type:'datetime',datetime:<UTC ISO via tallinnLocalToUtcIso>},{type:'_sharing',string:'domain'}] — the explicit _sharing prop is MANDATORY (program_item precedent, repertoireActions.ts:188-205: parent events have non-uniform sharing; omitting it can land a public schedule_item and drop domain-tier prop-defs from ordinary reads). Pin its presence with a NEGATIVE twin (a create payload without _sharing must fail the spec). edit = replaceEntityProperty (GET→POST-new→DELETE-old order, src/lib/entu/replaceProperty.ts). remove = DELETE entity/{itemId}. NO ordinal reads or writes anywhere.
6. Stale-response race: the schedule fetch attaches inside loadForSelected's flow under the page's hand-rolled generation guard (+page.svelte:138,287,304). Write a DETERMINISTICALLY ORDERED race spec per the house method: mock ONLY the async boundary with a test-held deferred, switch selected collective/event, then settle the stale response — the stale data must NOT reach the schedule state; failure must trip the real assertion, never a timeout.
7. Preserve page invariants: exactly one <main> and one <h1> (page.i18n-a11y.spec.ts:406,417 will enforce — your new section uses h2 or lower).

## Surface B — agenda (src/lib/components/agenda/AgendaList.svelte)
8. Day-list rows whose event has schedule items additionally show ONE compact chronological line — each item rendered as time + name, '·'-separated (precedent: event-detail tally line), in the row's secondary text style (row-duration treatment, text-[10px] text-ink-2). CRITICAL span shape: the line is one span (or one span per 'time name' PAIR) — NEVER a bare clock-only span; AgendaList.spec.ts:775,807 run containment checks over ALL row spans with negative pins like not.toContain('09:30').
9. Row-family scope RULED (PO comment 5558026158): BOTH families — upcoming rows AND the Recent section's rows (separate template, AgendaList.svelte:347-424) carry the times line when the event has items. Recent's line inherits the family's dimmer tone — NO special styling. Write the positive assertions for both families and the byte-unchanged negative assertions for both families' no-item rows.
10. BYTE-UNCHANGED fence, made testable: rows for events with NO schedule items render no times line — write an explicit NEGATIVE assertion (times-line testid absent on ordinary rows); no existing spec covers this (they are testid-scoped containment checks).
11. Data path: a NEW scheduleItemsByEventId record prop into AgendaList ONLY (mirror worksByEventId, AgendaList.svelte:106,149). The shared AgendaItem type is NOT extended (that would put schedule data one naive edit away from the month view). AgendaMonthView.svelte, its Props, and its rendered output stay byte-unchanged — assert its four-things row contract still holds with schedule data present in the system (page.agenda-month-view.spec.ts:21-25 is the fence; extend with a fixture where the event HAS schedule items and the month row shows none of them).
12. Bulk fetch: one call across visible event ids (mirror loadWorksAndManagement, routes/+page.svelte:1195-1212) with its OWN load-id guard composed with the shared requestId — deterministic race spec here too (same method as 6).
13. event.start_datetime remains the row's primary time, sort key, and day-grouping basis — pin that grouping/sort ignore schedule items (fixture: item earlier than event start must not move the row or its group).
14. Locale: 4-locale exact-text pins for every new user-facing key (imitate AgendaList.spec.ts:670-683). Times-line clock digits are locale-independent (formatTime combo takes no locale); day headers untouched.

## Integration tests (mandatory)
15. Real-route specs: the schedule section reachable on the actual event/[id] route; the times line reachable on the actual / (agenda) route with the real producer chain. New components/functions imported from non-test code.

New i18n keys: propose names following the event_detail_delete_* / event_create_* conventions; en+et+lv+uk all four files.

Verify every cited file:line against HEAD before relying on it (drift check). All specs must FAIL against current main (feature absent) — run and REPORT the failing output verbatim in your result summary; a spec that passes pre-implementation is a defect.
